in_sanskrit.name: गोप
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गो (go) + प (pa) = गोप (gopa) - गो (go) meaning 'cow' and प (pa) meaning 'protector' or 'guardian'.

in_hindi.name: गोपा
in_hindi.meaning: गोप (gop) + ा (a) = गोपा (gopa) - गो (go) meaning 'cow' and प (pa) meaning 'protector' or 'guardian' and ा (a) meaning 'addition' or 'extension'.

in_tamil.name: கோபா
in_tamil.meaning: கோ (ko) + பா (pa) = கோபா (kopa) - கோ (ko) meaning 'cow' and பா (pa) meaning 'protector' or 'guardian'.

in_telugu.name: గోప
in_telugu.meaning: గో (go) + ప (pa) = గోప (gopa) - గో (go) meaning 'cow' and ప (pa) meaning 'protector' or 'guardian'.

in_marathi.name: Gopa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gopa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Gopa was a cowherd, often depicted as the lover of Krishna. The name is derived from the Sanskrit root word ‘gop’, meaning ‘cowherd’.
